items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: the drummer was Nick Fatool, and now Nick Fatool had been out here like 5 days.

ctx.x: Well, that was because of that law. Now, the black local did enforce that, because I told you that was enforced on Lester, but now, here was a case where I'll tell you who the drummer was -- when I went back to see CBS that next Friday, the drummer was Nick Fatool, and now Nick Fatool had been out here like 5 days.
